items.statement: KTM volumes have recovered to respectable levels; forecast for coming months is very good; new Duke 790 launched with good US acceptance.

items.value: INR 600 crores, INR 1,000 crores to INR 1,200 crores
items.quote: See, from the ISRF facility, we are expecting to get around INR 600 crores turnover over a period of next 2 years, to start with. Then, it will scale up to around INR 1,000 crores to INR 1,200 crores over a period of 5 years.

items.statement: Vadinar expected turnover INR 300-600 crores after 3 years.
items.quote: So, after 3 years, we may get a turnover of around -- to start with around INR 300 crores to around INR 500 crores to INR 600 crores. That is for Vadinar.

items.statement: Tuticorin expected turnover INR 650-700 crores scaling to INR 1,800-2,000 crores over 7-8 years.
items.value: INR 650 crores to INR 700 crores, INR 1,800 crores to INR 2,000 crores
items.quote: But there also, we expect a turnover of around -- should start with around INR 650 crores to INR 700 crores to scale up to around INR 1,800 crores to INR 2,000 crores over a period of next 7 to 8 years.

items.statement: Capex to be funded 80:20 debt-equity, with 25% capex subsidy and 3% interest subvention.
items.quote: And as this capex will be spent over a period of next 5 years, and we will be going mostly through a debt-equity ratio of around 80:20. And there is also a Shipbuilding Development Scheme announced by the Government of India, by which we get a 25% capex subsidy for all these projects, and also the Interest Incentivisation Fund of around 3% subvention also, interest subvention also we'll get.

items.statement: No visibility on IAC-2 as it has not reached AoN stage.
items.quote: I would say there is no visibility, because as of now, it has not reached the AoN stage, because Navy has a procedure called the Approval of Necessity. Even as per our information, we don't have that authentic information, but it has not reached the AoN stage also.

items.statement: Defense pipeline: LPD 4 ~INR 32,000 cr, MCMV 12 ~INR 36,000 cr, P-17 Bravo 7 ~INR 49,000 cr.
items.value: INR 32,000 crores, INR 36,000 crores, INR 49,000 crores
items.quote: LPD from defense side, the major order which we are expecting soon is around LPD four numbers, that will be approximately INR 32,000 crores. Then, 12 numbers MCMV, approximately INR 36,000 crores. Then, P-17 Bravo, seven numbers, that will be approximately INR 49,000 crores.

items.statement: Revenue growth expected in line with blended three-year historical growth for FY27.
items.quote: So, the growth should be in line with the historical numbers. So, blended three-year growth is, I think, a good number to look at for FY27.

items.statement: Margins expected broadly similar to last year; recovery visible in H2 FY27.
items.quote: No, in '27 also, you can see the recovery of the margin in next half year.

items.statement: Four projects commissioning Q4 FY27 to Q3 FY28 with aggregate peak revenue potential of INR500 crores.
items.quote: So, in total, the 4 projects commissioning between Q4 FY27 to Q3 FY28 has an aggregate peak revenue potential of about INR500 crores at full utilization against a FY26 revenue base of INR445 crores.

items.statement: Brownfield OEM contact sensor plant of 50,000 sq ft to be commissioned by Q3 FY28, peak revenue INR120 crores.
items.quote: We are also building a brownfield plant of about 50,000 square feet within Unit 1 for OEM contact sensors, which is expected to be commissioned by Q3 FY28, which will have a peak revenue potential of about INR120 crores

items.statement: New 50,000 sq ft plant within Unit 6 for medium-voltage heaters to be completed by Q1 FY28, peak revenue INR200 crores.
items.quote: The new products will be supported by a new 50,000 square foot plant within Unit 6 that is expected to be completed by Q1 FY28, which will carry a peak revenue potential of about INR200 crores.

items.statement: Greenfield Unit 8 for specialized cables to be completed by Q2 FY28, peak revenue INR60 crores.
items.quote: So, for cables, we have also started construction for Unit 8. It is a greenfield project and should be completed by Q2 FY28 with a peak revenue potential of INR60 crores.

items.statement: Victura JV facility production to commence by Q4 FY27, peak revenue potential INR120 crores.
items.quote: For the joint venture with Victura Technologies, we have signed an agreement to acquire an 80,000 square foot facility that already has a shed built on top of it. So, production should commence by Q4 FY27 with a peak revenue potential of about INR120 crores.

items.statement: OEM and new products expected to contribute more than 25% of revenue starting FY28.
items.quote: So, all in all, we expect, I mean, especially the OEM part plus the new product part, to start contributing significantly, I mean, more than 25% of our revenue starting FY28.

items.statement: New age industry products expected to grow at high 20s or 30s over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: the growth, I would say, for the new age industry or the new kind of products would be much faster, and we expect this to be in a double-digit number or maybe in the high 20s or 30s in the next few years, next maybe 2 years-3 years.

items.statement: EDGE series pyrometers co-developed with Micro-Epsilon to start dispatches in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We are also launching a new series of next-generation pyrometers, the EDGE series, which is co-developed by our partner, Micro-Epsilon, which should start dispatches Q3 this year.

items.statement: Medium-voltage heaters targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: So, these heaters have already been tested up to 7.2 kilowatts and we're targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Typical heavy industry order book is 4-4.5 months; OEM visibility is 9-12 months.
items.quote: So, our typical customer base, which is based on heavy industries, so the order book is like 4, 4.5 months. That is a typical order book for us. But these kind of OEM players, so they have a much larger visibility. So, there the order cycle, like visibility could be maybe for 9 to 12 months' visibility is there.

items.statement: Raw materials booked at order receipt; price fluctuations passed through to customers.
items.quote: And regarding the inventory price fluctuation, actually we book the raw materials at the time of receiving the orders. So, we pass through the fluctuations to the customer.

items.statement: No negative revenue impact expected next quarters from geopolitical situation; mid-term positive.
items.quote: For the next quarters, I would I don't think there is any negative impact. For maybe next years, it could be a positive impact.

items.statement: Management does not provide annual revenue guidance but will give volume guidance each quarter
items.quote: As a company, we don't give the revenue guidance on an -- overall basis. On a quarterly basis, we will have the -- we will have the earnings call, and the visibility of the next quarter is available to us as we close a particular quarter.

items.statement: Expects volume growth trend to continue in Q2 FY27
items.quote: We believe that this volume growth trend should continue in the quarter 2 as well.

items.statement: Generic annual capex for group is INR35-40 crores; cold chain warehouse to be operational next quarter
items.quote: So the generic capex plan every year for the group is around INR35 crores to INR40 crores per annum. And this is how we have been growing, barring the cold chain warehouse project, which is going to be operational during next quarter.

items.statement: Board approved INR30 crores for expansion into five new Asian geographies; 10-15% is capex for office/warehouse setup
items.quote: Out of the INR30 crores that we are going to invest over a period of time, generally the capex in our industry is very low. Around 10% to 15% out of this INR30 crores will be the capex, which will be the initial setting up cost of the offices and smaller warehouses that may be required.

items.statement: INR20 crores approved for investment into existing overseas subsidiaries in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Vietnam
items.quote: This is basically for our subsidiaries in the in the UAE, in Saudi Arabia, these are the primarily and Vietnam.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA increased 83.5% YoY to INR50.12 crores; PAT margin improved from 1.72% to 2.2%
items.quote: The profitability on the EBITDA, operating EBITDA, has improved from INR27.31 crores on a consolidated basis to INR50.12 crores, which is an increase of 83.5% year-on-year basis if we compare the 2 quarters.

items.statement: Employee benefit expense as % of revenue reduced from 4.41% to 2.94%; other expenses reduced from 2.5% to 1.76% YoY
items.quote: A number which I also want to highlight is as regards the employee benefit expense as a percentage of revenue, quarter-on-quarter, if we compare on the year-on basis, has reduced from 4.41% to 2.94%, and the other expenses have also gone down as a percentage of revenue from 2.5% to 1.76%.

items.statement: Fuel cost is a full pass-through; yield increases driven by fuel index rise from ~USD61 to ~USD110 per barrel
items.quote: The fuel cost is always a pass-through for us. Whatever the fuel index, which is globally available, the indexes are very easily available and tangible across the world. So those are absolutely passed through to the customers, whether they are in air or in ocean, even in trucking.

items.statement: Air cargo volume grew 23% YoY; ocean freight volume grew 18% YoY; express revenue grew 64% to INR63 crores
items.quote: If we talk about the realization, the realizations have improved. There has been a volume growth of 23% in our main revenue segment, which is air cargo operation. In ocean freight, there is a realization growth of more than 64% and a volume growth of 18%.

items.statement: Skyways air export grew 19% vs India market growth of 3.8% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: India in this quarter versus the Q1 of 2026, India's air export market was 2,94,000 metric tons in Q1 '26 -- in Q1 '27, it's gone to about 3.06 lakh metric tons, which is about a 3.8% increase, okay? And Skyways, in the same period, actually on the air export side has grown 19%.

items.statement: Pharma share of business grew from 8-9% pre-Odyssey to 23% last year; sustained in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Before Odyssey had come into our portfolio, we were about 8% to 9% of our business was pharmaceutical, and which grew to 23% last year. We've actually managed to sustain the volumes and the percentage of pharmaceutical in this even in this difficult period.

items.statement: Odyssey standalone revenue grew from ~INR130 crores to INR182 crores quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: Even on the Odyssey, the number that you asked about, so there has been significant growth in the standalone business of Odyssey as well. And from a INR130-odd crores revenue, quarter-on-quarter, it is now to INR182 crores.

items.statement: EOW matter sub judice in final stages; management sees no material financial impact and is confident of positive outcome
items.quote: So, the matter is still sub judice and under investigation in its final stages. And currently, as we see it, we don't see any possible impact on us financially on this case.

items.statement: Swissport bid unsuccessful; was second highest bidder; will bid on future projects with alliance
items.quote: So, the Swissport, the bid that we had given for the project, we were the second highest bidder for the project, so that has not obviously materialized. And going forward, other projects, we will be bidding with the alliance that we have created with Swissport.

items.statement: ASAP tech platform in final pilot testing across air, ocean, express; trucking in final development; launch expected in 30-60 days
items.quote: As I had mentioned in my opening address, that we have, we have building this platform, and it's it's right in the final stages of its closing now. I think we should be able to put it in operation over the next 30 to 60 days.

items.statement: International expansion into 5 new Asian markets approved; gestation 2-3 years to solid base; EBITDA break-even 15-18 months
items.quote: Usually, what we have seen historically is that anything between 2 to 4 years is what a new international market takes for us to make it a good, solid base for us in those markets. We feel that we will be able to definitely improve that and maybe do in 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: No short-term impact on FY27; implementation from April 1; hope no impact on FY29.
items.quote: This is not going to have any short -term impact on FY27, because even in this paper, it said the implementation will happen on 1st o f April, only. And till that time, we have time to obviously go back, discuss, and put our points there

items.statement: Endeavor to reach similar situation as before by FY29; FY28 challenging.
items.quote: Our endeavor would be to try and get to the similar situation as we had by FY29. FY28 will be a year of challenges and discovery, maybe.

items.statement: General insurance net present value between one-third to 40% of current.
items.quote: But in terms of general insurance, it is between one-third to 40% of what we have today. That's a very serious impact on revenue.

items.statement: Life insurance net present value similar to today, no major impact.
items.quote: From the current regulations, in terms of net present value, we think the life insurance net present value is similar to what we have today, and should not have a major impact.

items.statement: Combined operating ratio model: lower claims or commissions can reflect in consumer pricing, driving volumes.
items.quote: With most of our general insurance partners, we work on a combined operating ratio model. What that implies is, if any component of the combined operating ratio, whether it is claims ratio or whether it is commissions, they come down, from whatever was the ongoing, that can reflect itself in terms of consumer pricing.

items.statement: Price elasticity at least 1; expect 15-20% volume growth if price reduction passed to customers.
items.quote: Like, at least what was shown to us was that there's a price elasticity of at least 1. Which means for every 1% reduction in price, there should be at least 1% growth. So, my view is at least 15-20% we should get back in terms of growth, if that is being given back to the customer in terms of price.

items.statement: Potential 10-15% revenue-to-cost synergy, not committed yet.
items.quote: there may be a 10% or so, and I'm not putting 10% out there right now, there may be a 10-15%, let us say, current revenue-to-cost synergy possible.

items.statement: Contact center is almost 20% of revenue; rationalization opportunities exist.
items.quote: And so clearly, this is almost 20% of our revenue is the contact center, and we will have some rationalization

items.statement: Will cut marketing and operational hiring to avoid over-expending until situation settles.
items.quote: But going forward, till this thing settles itself, clearly we will have to start cutting marketing and sort of our operational hiring, etc., to make sure that we don't over-expend ourselves.

items.statement: No mass layoffs; no knee-jerk decisions; calibrate growth to new reality.
items.quote: I just want to be very clear that we are going to make no knee-jerk decisions, there will be no mass layoffs of any kind, we run the company for long-term growth, and we will calibrate that growth to the new reality, but at no point are we going to make decisions which will hurt our colleagues in any sort of unfair way.

items.statement: Credit life could open up as a market opportunity under proposed changes.
items.quote: If credit life goes in the direction that is being proposed, then I think credit life could, again, be in a market that will open up for us.

items.statement: Non-insurance products may be allowed, creating opportunities.
items.quote: There is also a discussion around non-insurance products. I don't know how exactly that will be implemented, but if that is implemented, then that also has opportunities for us.

items.statement: Exploring manufacturing insurance or reinsurance; early stages.
items.quote: and we are also exploring all opti ons in terms of manufacturing, whether that be insurance or reinsurance, so we will explore those, we're at early stages of explorat ion of that

items.statement: Higher probability of having own manufacturing capability to defend financials.
items.quote: I would say, yes, there would be a higher probability of us having some manufacturing capability of our own, because we have to defen d ourselves in that situation, where our f inancials are impacted, but the benefit is not passed on to the customer, and thus we are not allowed to win

items.statement: POSP business challenged top-line but may improve bottom-line.
items.quote: from a top-line perspective, it would definitely be challenged if all this is going to be implemented, but then actually, from a bottom-line perspective, it may actually work in a different direction.

items.statement: No plans to acquire small brokers or agents due to DNA mismatch.
items.quote: We are not in a mode of acquiring any of the small brokers or agents, because, fundamentally, the DNA doesn't match.

items.statement: Revenue to grow minimum 20% YoY in FY27; PAT to grow 25-30% YoY
items.quote: As I told you, we'll be growing at about 20% minimum year-on-year. And bottom line will grow at minimum at 25% to 30%. PAT will keep on going up by about 25% to 30%, top line will grow up by 20%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target 24-25% for FY27
items.quote: EBITDA margin will be maintained at about 24% to 25%.

items.statement: INR30 crore capex planned for FY27 from IPO proceeds to add capacity
items.quote: We have got INR30 crores allotted for capex this year, and we'll be implementing that within a period of one year.

items.statement: Board approved acquisition of 6.5 acres land for new plant; estimated investment INR350-500 crore over 2-3 years
items.quote: I am preparing that for INR350 crores to INR500 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to improve 0.5-1% annually for 2-3 years to reach 25%
items.quote: We are planning to increase our EBITDA margin year-on-year by about 0.5%, 1%, so that we'll touch 25%. Okay? For a period of two, three years.

items.statement: Domestic growth expected 15-20% in FY27 vs industry 7-8% due to share gains and new OEMs
items.quote: Even domestic business also I'm expecting a growth of about 15% to 20%. Although the business in India is growing at about 7%, 8%, we will grow at 20%.

items.statement: Export mix target 50% in 5 years from current ~30%; US capped at 25%, focus on Europe, Australia, others
items.quote: We have already prepared a plan for five years, and in five years, we have decided to go for 50% export and 50% domestic. That is the plan. Today, we are at about 30% export.

items.statement: No traditional order book; annual schedules from OEMs provide visibility
items.quote: Order book is more or less, more or less, we have got schedules for annual schedules from all OEMs. So, we don't have an order book.

items.statement: Capacity to double from 35 lakh to 70 lakh fittings/month in 3 years; current utilization 60-70%
items.quote: Today, we are manufacturing around 35 lakhs of fittings every month, and the proceeds that we have got now from IPO, we are going to go to 70 lakhs per month.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk limits US exposure to 25% of revenue; diversifying to Europe, Australia, Dubai
items.quote: We don't want to increase that. As I told you, the philosophy and policy of Hy-Tech is to spread the business all over. What happens if the Trump relationship changes?

items.statement: IRIS railway certification and DRDO defence registration obtained; first revenue expected in 5-6 months
items.quote: We are also registered with DRDO, that is a defence organization, so we have now chance to enter into defence as well. And we have also registered ourselves in Cochin Shipyard and Mazagon Dock.

items.statement: Setting up 100% US subsidiary with warehouse; elder son to lead US business
items.quote: We are therefore opening a company in USA, and that is also being sanctioned in the board today, and we are on the on the way to form that company.

items.statement: Developed stainless steel fittings for data centers and oil & gas; commercial entry expected FY28-29
items.quote: We have just started manufacturing these fittings, and we'll be entering into this data center opportunity over a period of next one year's time positively.

items.statement: Two rotary transfer machines installed; four more planned to double productivity
items.quote: We have purchased one rotary transfer machine, which churns out around 70,000 pieces per month. And it's a single, completely automatic machine with one person operating the machine, and this is going to give us tremendous amount of speed of manufacturing, and this is something which we have already got two machines with us, and we are going to buy four more machines in the near future.

items.statement: Five-year revenue target INR500 crore implying 20-25% CAGR
items.quote: Five years down the line, we'll go to 500.

items.statement: Targeting 20-25% growth in revenue and EBITDA for current fiscal year, plus/minus 5%.
items.quote: Based on our current visibility and business outlook, we are definitely targeting 20% and 25% growth for this current fiscal year in our revenues and our EBITDA, respectively. Of course, this could be plus-minus some percentage, 5%, due to this global operating environmental uncertainties that we are all aware of today.

items.statement: Plans to invest INR200-250 crores annually for next two to three years.
items.value: INR200 crores to INR250 crores each year
items.quote: But the visibility that I can currently give you based on our operating cash flows is minimum INR200 crores to INR250 crores each year for the next two to three years. Of course, as our surplus cash flows improves, we will do more capex.

items.statement: Signed 5-year take-or-pay contract for insulin drug substance.
items.quote: Third, a five-year take-or-pay biopharmaceutical agreement for insulin drug substance supply.

items.statement: 10-year take-or-pay agreement with US-based alternate protein player.
items.quote: First, a 10-year take-or-pay agreement with a U.S.-based alternate protein player already in place.

items.statement: 10-year take-or-pay term sheet with Europe-based alternate protein player, agreement in advanced stage.
items.quote: Second, another 10-year take-or-pay term sheet with a Europe-based alternate protein player in place, and the agreement as well is in advanced stage with signing very soon.

items.statement: API gross margins to continue around 60%, EBITDA close to 30%.
items.quote: And we'll continue to do gross margins around 60%. Of course, we are currently much higher than 60%, but I think that's the base that that we expect our business to continue with. And similarly on the EBITDA lines, we are we are very close to 30% margins, and this is what we'd like to maintain.

items.statement: New businesses expected to have gross margins >70% and EBITDA margins >35% at maturity.
items.value: higher than 70% as gross margins and higher than 35% as EBITDA margins
items.quote: Usually, this industry trend is higher than 70% as gross margins and higher than 35% as EBITDA margins. And because we are into the same orbit where we have a very differentiated fermentation biotech CMO and very differentiated device called dual-chamber platform, right? So, we believe that we should be in the similar margin profile.

items.statement: Biotech CDMO demand strong; may need to build 4x capacity in 2-3 years.
items.quote: And, of course, when we talk about the Phase 1, we're already talking about 4 times bigger capacities, I think over next 2 years to 3 years. And this is the visibility that I'm giving you only from our existing two customers that we have signed agreements/term sheet with.

items.statement: API share of revenue to drop below half in 5-6 years as new businesses grow.
items.quote: Now, it is almost 100%, right? It's more than 90%, so to say, right? And, of course, as the DCV sales kicks in, our CDMO biotech business, this will start dropping down. But I think going forward, let's say, 5, 6 years of vision if you're to talk about, this should be definitely less than half.

items.statement: First couple of quarters lumpy due to new business expenses without revenue; strong H2 expected.
items.quote: While we expect the first couple of quarters to remain lumpy due to the drag of new business expenses without corresponding revenue in the same period, we expect a very strong second half on the back of milestone cash flows coming in and some small revenues from biotech CDMO services in quarter four.

items.statement: New business revenues expected to commence in next 6 to 12 months.
items.quote: Lastly, before I conclude, I would like to re-emphasize that we would have invested cumulatively more than INR1,000 crores in capex for the new businesses, and revenues from this new capex is expected to commence in the next 6 months to 12 months.

items.statement: Operating expenses from new businesses to continue at INR23 crores per quarter for next 2-3 quarters.
items.quote: On the expenses drag of expenses from this new businesses, this INR23 crores as a run rate should more or less continue for the next two, three quarters in terms of the run rate of expenses, and similarly on the depreciation about INR11 crores.

items.statement: R&D spending to continue at 3-4% of sales, may increase to 5%.
items.quote: So, we consistently have been investing about 3% to 4% of our sales as R&D, and we expect this to continue, probably with a slight increase as well to about 5% in the future.

items.statement: API business growing at high single digits.
items.quote: So, our API segment is currently, as I said, we are looking at the growth in high single digits, right? So, it's not flat, but it's not also dynamically growing, but it's growing in a in a high single digit.

items.statement: 600 KL Phase 1 expansion to start construction in Q3 FY27, take 15-18 months.
items.quote: But, yes, this 600 KL is with a customer whom we have already signed the term sheet with, and we should be going ahead with this construction starting Q3 itself as '27.

items.statement: Biologics revenues to start early next fiscal year.
items.quote: So, we expect not all this to happen in the current fiscal year. Hence, the revenues from our biologics division is likely to kick in, in early next fiscal year.

items.statement: Revenue from Sydney AI factory to start from Q3 FY27.
items.quote: So, from Q3 onwards, we will see the revenue coming in from the AI factory in Sydney.

items.statement: Targeting early to mid Q3 for AI factory go-live.
items.quote: So, we are targeting somewhere early Q1 or mid of Q3. Early or mid of Q3.

items.statement: Targeting PAT margins of 15% to 20% on GPU deals.
items.quote: We are targeting PAT margins in the range of 15% to 20%. So, that's our target PAT margin. We will not work for anything lesser than that.

items.statement: Domestic order book around INR3,000 crores with 3-year duration.
items.quote: Domestic business, we have got around INR3,000 crores of an order book with us. International is much larger than that.

items.statement: Order book duration is 3 years.
items.quote: Duration of the order book is 3 years.

items.statement: Targeting to deploy around 1,500 GPUs by mid or end of Q4 FY27.
items.quote: The target is to touch around 1,500 GPUs. We'll be deploying those by January or February next year, which will be mid of Q4. Mid of Q4 or end of Q4.

items.statement: Targeting INR1,500 crores capex in FY27, with additional INR1,500 crores.
items.quote: FY27, we are targeting to conclude around INR1,500 crores of capex, and additional INR1,500 crores, whatever has happened, I exactly don't have the numbers in front of me right now, but we will be doing additional INR1,500 crores of capex in FY27.

items.statement: Billing GPU services at $5-$6 per GPU per hour, in line with industry.
items.quote: So, the industry standard where people are currently billing upwards of $5 per GPU per hour that is what everyone in the industry, $5, $6 per hour. So, we are also going to bill our customer in that range only.

items.statement: Strong funnel of more than 50,000 GPUs.
items.quote: We have a strong funnel of more than 50,000 GPUs right now, and we are trying to figure out how we will deliver that, from where, all locations, which all locations we can deliver the pipeline.

items.statement: Domestic business seeing CAGR of 30% to 40%.
items.quote: Domestic, currently, we are seeing a CAGR of 30% to 40%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue split: IaaS 51%, Managed Services 31.31%, SaaS 17.55%.
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, our IaaS revenue was 51% of the total revenue, Managed Service revenue was 31.31%, and SaaS revenue was 17.55%. And this will go steady in future years as well.

items.statement: GPU availability is a constraint with delivery delays of 4-9 months.
items.quote: It is already a constraint. There is a delivery timeline delay of 4 months, 6 months, 9 months also. So, we are leveraging our relationships to get the deliveries expedited.

items.statement: New India setup funded 30% customer advance, 30% debt, 30% IPO proceeds.
items.quote: So, we'll be putting a balance of 30 -30-30 each, advance from customer and lending and 30% coming from the IPO proceeds, so that is what the target is.

items.statement: Billing for new capacity to start from Q1 FY28.
items.quote: Billing will start from Q1.
